purpose: Evaluate whether four questioned preprocessing choices materially change recording-level results without selecting a preferred pipeline after observing accuracy.

known_before_freeze: The Route A cross-task and Arithmetic LOSO results had been inspected.
The matched three-split audit and the complete Stroop LOSO 14-method results had been inspected.
No preprocessing-sensitivity result had been generated or inspected.
timing.selection_prohibition: No variant may replace the reference pipeline because it produces a higher accuracy. Any future protocol change requires a separately versioned experiment and independent validation.

data.dataset: OpenBCI Cyton stress dataset used by Route A
data.excluded_columns: all marker, packet-status, accelerometer, counter and other auxiliary columns
data.fft_correction: The frozen code zero-pads each 2125-sample window to the next power of two, 4096. It does not use a 2048-point FFT.

shared_feature_pipeline.bandpass: fourth-order zero-phase Butterworth, 0.5-55 Hz, applied to the continuous recording before windowing

variants.changed_factor: replace within-window standardization with whole-recording per-channel z-score
variants.normalization: continuous-recording per-channel z-score after bandpass and before windowing

variants.changed_factor: set the spectral 50-Hz attenuation multiplier from 0.03 to 1.0
jointly neutralize the two coupled legacy spectral emphasis multipliers
variants.grouping_reason: Both constants are legacy spectral emphasis heuristics questioned together by the supervisor; they are neutralized jointly and will not be interpreted as separate causal effects.

learner.fairness_rule: identical learner and hyperparameters for every preprocessing variant

recording_disjoint.folds: two balanced folds; each validation fold contains one recording from each binary class
recording_disjoint.repeat_policy: repeated split results are averaged within participant and are never treated as independent samples

participant_disjoint_loso.hyperparameter_selection: none, so no inner model-selection loop is required for this fixed diagnostic learner

cross_task.training: fit once on every source-task window and evaluate target-task recordings separately for each participant
cross_task.limitation: task-disjoint but not participant-disjoint because the same participants contribute the other task to training

outcomes_and_statistics.recording_probability: geometric mean of window probabilities followed by renormalization
outcomes_and_statistics.paired_test: two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank with Pratt zero handling
outcomes_and_statistics.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg correction across every non-reference variant-by-evaluation comparison in this analysis
outcomes_and_statistics.claim_status: descriptive post-hoc sensitivity only; no superiority, non-inferiority or safety claim

cache_and_reproducibility.cache_policy: recompute or load only from variant-specific directories under output 37
cache_and_reproducibility.forbidden: never read the frozen Route A feature cache as a sensitivity-variant cache
cache_and_reproducibility.reference_parity_check: the independently rebuilt reference feature matrices must match the frozen Route A 272-dimensional feature matrices within explicit numerical tolerance before model fitting
required_outputs: paired differences versus reference with raw and BH-adjusted p-values
